note: The eleventh session chose, for the first time, to leave the letter entirely: Rosa's view through the sky hole in Cascade won clearly, with Sunny's budding graft second. Mireille's crossing strokes are now the longest-standing unrealised proposal in the archive, five sessions running.

proposals.direction: Go through the sky hole. Make the next work the view from the other side of the letter: a wide blue field with one small square of vellum grid seen from behind, far off, and Kite's fallen tiles as distant specks drifting away from it.
proposals.rationale: The fifth hole in Cascade showed sky, and after thirty-three works the room agreed the archive has never once stepped outside the letter to look back at it.

proposals.direction: Let the graft bud. Two leaves and one small flower on the join, so the repair becomes the only living part of the line.
proposals.rationale: She likes repairs that turn into plants.

proposals.direction: Remove one of the nine seeds and leave its empty cell, with a faint outline where it was, so the catalogue records a loss.
proposals.rationale: A collection is defined by what is missing from it.

proposals.direction: Freeze the pool. Turn the mosaic water to ice with the reflection locked inside it and the fall stopped mid-air.
proposals.rationale: Now that water has arrived he wants to see it stop.

proposals.direction: Let the two hands cross with a third stroke that starts in ink and ends in light.
